recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-32491 unless Pharmacy opens a new issue to revisit the value set or binding strength.
issue_request: FHIR-32491 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy WG change request asking for MedicationPrescription/MedicationRequest.substitution.allowed[x] to be tighter than an example binding, with Preferred suggested and extensible considered.
initial_application: The change appears to have been applied by git commit 7acfd680713d0152367c6841b366974c594b4ec0, which listed FHIR-32491 and changed source/medicationrequest/structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml from an example to a preferred binding for MedicationRequest.substitution.allowed[x]. Current blame still attributes the preferred strength line to that commit.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists medicationrequest=MedicationRequest as an active resource, so the StructureDefinition source is in current build scope. Pharmacy May 2021 WGM minutes corroborate the Jira resolution: common systems such as eRx and claims use other code systems, so the WG voted 5-0-0 for Preferred rather than extensible. Later bounded Jira and git searches found no reversal for this element, binding name, or value set.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already has strength="preferred" for MedicationRequest.substitution.allowed[x] bound to http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/v3-ActSubstanceAdminSubstitutionCode.
